question: Which edition of the Pro Kabaddi League was started in December 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 10th edition of the Pro Kabaddi League commenced in December 2023.
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) was first launched in 2014, and it has gained immense popularity over the years.
 
• PKL is a professional-level kabaddi league in India, organized by Mashal Sports and backed by Star India.
 
• Each season of the league features teams representing various cities across India, competing in a franchise-based format.
 
• The league has played a significant role in popularizing the sport of kabaddi in India and worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of Pro Kabaddi League**

 
 
• The league was inspired by the success of the Kabaddi tournament at the 2006 Asian Games and the Kabaddi World Cup held in 2004.
 
• It was launched with the objective of transforming kabaddi into a professional sport with a large fan base.
 
• The inaugural season took place in 2014 with eight teams participating.
 
 
 
• **Format of PKL**
 
 
• The league follows a franchise-based model similar to that of the Indian Premier League (IPL) in cricket.
 
• Each team comprises players from various countries, including India, Iran, South Korea, and others.
 
• The league is played in a double round-robin format followed by playoffs and a final to determine the champion.
 
 
 
• **Impact of PKL**
 
 
• PKL has significantly increased the popularity and viewership of kabaddi in India and internationally.
 
• The league has provided a platform for local talent to showcase their skills and gain recognition.
 
• It has also contributed to the economic growth of the sport by attracting sponsors, advertisers, and media coverage.
 
 
 
• **Recent Developments in PKL**
 
 
• The league has introduced technological advancements such as video referrals and data analytics to enhance the viewing experience.
 
• PKL has expanded its reach by broadcasting matches in multiple languages and on digital platforms.
 
• The league continues to innovate with new team formations, player auctions, and fan engagement activities.
